notes.title: Bugfix Patch v0.6.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that was preventing earning progress towards the achievement "Heads Up"

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.0 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
Updates

Added initial set of achievements
Randomized order that platforms lower in Arcade Mode
New effects when unlocking weapons
Slight improvements to tracking weapon velocity

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue with hit reactions
Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s hand to disappear after picking up a dismembered limb
Other misc code optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where depending on play space, the player could spawn on the arena elevator outside of the trigger for making it go up to start the level

notes.title: Transfusion Release - January 13th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44045978/6d2a0d1e55104a44877eed20be59cb4f801b3893.pngHey Everyone

We're so exited to release the game in Early Access next week! It's been a crazy 3-year journey creating the game so far, and it's awesome to have something that we're ready to share with the world.

Our initial release will have a fully playable Arcade mode version of the game, and as we continue to work on the game we'll be adding new content and working on a Story Mode! 

Thank you for checking out our game, and we hope you enjoy!
